title: Communication Lost
fullDescription: Communicating heat pumps lose sync with thermostat/indoor unit. Wiring or board fault.
safetyWarning: Power off before handling comm wiring.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: High Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Discharge pressure too high - dirty condenser coil, failed fan, or overcharge. In cooling the outdoor coil must shed heat; blocked coil is the usual culprit.
safetyWarning: High refrigerant pressure is hazardous. Only EPA-certified techs should open the refrigerant circuit.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Low Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Suction pressure below threshold - low refrigerant (leak), restricted filter drier, or low indoor airflow.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Outdoor Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Defrost control relies on coil temp sensor. Failure blocks proper defrost cycles and heating operation.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Reversing Valve Fault
fullDescription: Stuck or failed reversing valve means the unit cannot switch between heat and cool. Mechanical or coil failure.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Compressor Protection
shortDescription: Compressor thermal or current overload tripped.
fullDescription: Compressor is drawing excessive current, overheating, or running outside envelope. Check start components and refrigerant charge.
safetyWarning: Line voltage capacitors can store lethal charge.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Outdoor Fan Fault
shortDescription: Outdoor fan motor not running properly.
fullDescription: Fan stalled, overloaded, or failed capacitor. Without fan, high-pressure trips follow quickly.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Defrost Cycle Fault
fullDescription: Heat pump cannot complete a defrost cycle. Causes: sensor fault, reversing valve issue, or low refrigerant.
safetyWarning: Do not hammer ice off coils - damage results.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Indoor Coil Freeze
fullDescription: Evaporator ice from low airflow or low refrigerant. Turn off, thaw, diagnose root cause.
safetyWarning: Water damage risk from thawing ice.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: Internal control error. Power cycle may clear; persistent requires board replacement.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Inducer Pressure Fault
fullDescription: Inducer pressure switch did not respond as expected.

fixSteps.title: Replace part
fixSteps.instruction: Swap failed sensor, capacitor, or contactor.

whenToCallPro: Compressor or sealed system work must be performed by a licensed HVAC technician.

title: Reversing Valve Fault
fullDescription: Code 126 fires when the AccuLink board commands a mode change but coil temps don't track — valve stuck.
whenToCallPro: Sealed-system pro.

title: Discharge Temp High
fullDescription: Code 127 sets when compressor discharge temp exceeds safe limit; lockout follows.
whenToCallPro: Charge issue.

title: EXV Step Error
shortDescription: Electronic expansion valve out of step.
fullDescription: Code 161 indicates the EXV motor steps don't match commanded position.
whenToCallPro: Always.

title: Defrost Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Code 174 indicates the defrost-initiate sensor is malfunctioning.
whenToCallPro: Board if sensor OK.

title: Defrost Termination Fail
fullDescription: Code 175 means the defrost cycle ran for max time without coil temp rising to terminate.
whenToCallPro: Refrigerant pro.

title: Outdoor Coil Sensor Open
fullDescription: Code 211 indicates the outdoor coil sensor reads open.
whenToCallPro: Defrost board next.

title: Suction Pressure Sensor
fullDescription: Code 212 indicates the suction transducer is sending invalid voltage.
whenToCallPro: Always.

title: Outdoor Fan Speed Mismatch
shortDescription: Condenser fan RPM out of range.
fullDescription: Code 260 reports the outdoor ECM fan failed to reach commanded speed.
whenToCallPro: OEM ECM.

title: Compressor Discharge Over-Temp
fullDescription: Code 320 sets when discharge thermistor exceeds safe limit; lockout follows.
whenToCallPro: Charge issue.

title: Indoor/Outdoor Mismatch
fullDescription: Code 400 fires when AccuLink detects incompatible indoor and outdoor models.
whenToCallPro: Always — match per OEM.

title: 130 — Outdoor Fan Failure
shortDescription: Outdoor fan ECM not running during call.
fullDescription: American Standard AccuLink communicating heat pumps fault 130 = outdoor fan ECM no tach feedback within 30 sec.
whenToCallPro: ECM programming.

title: 131 — Outdoor Fan Locked Rotor
fullDescription: Code 131 = ECM cannot rotate. Ice or debris.
whenToCallPro: Bearing = motor.

title: 180 — Discharge Temperature High
fullDescription: AccuLink fault 180 protects compressor from low charge / TXV / airflow restriction.
whenToCallPro: EPA tech.

title: 198 — Crankcase Heater Open
fullDescription: Code 198 = AS variable-speed monitors crankcase heater current. Open circuit risks flood-back.
whenToCallPro: Relay = board.

faq.a: Liquid refrigerant in compressor on start = damage.

title: 310 — Outdoor Coil Sensor Drift
fullDescription: Code 310 = soft fault on coil sensor.
whenToCallPro: Wire issue = tech.

title: 420 — Inverter Drive Capacitor Aging
fullDescription: AS variable-speed inverter drive predicts capacitor failure - schedule replacement.
whenToCallPro: Drive replacement tech.

title: 520 — Indoor Comm Lost
fullDescription: Code 520 = comm bus loss between AS variable outdoor and indoor.
whenToCallPro: Board = tech.

title: 601 — Reversing Valve Sense Mismatch
fullDescription: Code 601 fires after RV command, sensor pair did not flip temperatures.
whenToCallPro: Brazing = tech.

title: 710 — Inverter Drive Overcurrent
fullDescription: Code 710 = AS inverter drive overcurrent. Flood-back, crankcase, mechanical.
whenToCallPro: Inverter tech.

title: 802 — Outdoor Air Sensor Failure
fullDescription: Code 802 disables balance-point control. System reverts to default 35F.
whenToCallPro: Wire routing = tech.
